name: CETC
summary:
China Electronics Technology Group Corporation, known as CETC, is an electronics and information-technology group whose robotics activities span complete machines and core components. Its embodied-intelligence work draws on capabilities in sensing, communication, control and system integration.

At the 2026 World Robot Conference, CETC presented the Exploration D1 humanoid, Baihong Exploration exoskeleton, wheeled-legged robots and electric joints. Its demonstrations connected environmental perception with interaction and physical execution. These products place its robotics work across mobility assistance, intelligent inspection and broader embodied systems, supported by the group's development of both robot hardware and underlying electronic technologies.
